source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    original = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rays = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = original[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and original[rr][cc] == color):
                    continue
                for er, ec, vr, vc in ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (rr, cc, dr, dc)):
                    if any(0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w and original[ar][ac] != bg
                           for ar, ac in ((er-1, ec), (er+1, ec), (er, ec-1), (er, ec+1))):
                        continue
                    ar, ac = er + vr, ec + vc
                    while 0 <= ar < h and 0 <= ac < w:
                        rays.add((ar, ac, color))
                        ar += vr
                        ac += vc
    for r, c, color in rays:
        if original[r][c] == bg:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
